1.author: St. Augustine
1.text: 'The Lord ruleth me, and I shall want nothing.' The Church speaks of Christ: my Shepherd is the Lord Jesus Christ, and therefore nothing shall be wanting to me. 'In a place of pasture there hath He placed me.' In the place of the new pasture of fresh grass, there hath He brought me to faith, that I should be nourished. 'He hath brought me up on the water of refreshing,' on the water of Baptism, where they are refreshed who have lost health and strength.
